allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add Z Contouring \(ZAA\) feature for smoother top surfaces

Dynamically adjusts Z heights within layers to follow actual model
surface geometry, reducing visible stair-stepping on top surfaces
without requiring smaller layer heights. Uses ray-casting against
the model mesh via IndexedMesh AABB tree.

New settings: zaa_enabled, zaa_min_z, zaa_minimize_perimeter_height,
zaa_region_disable, zaa_dont_alternate_fill_direction.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

PowerShell("main vs upstream/main \(ahead behind\):"; git rev-list --left-right --count main...upstream/main; "custom-infill vs upstream/main:"; git rev-list --left-right --count feature/custom-infill...upstream/main; "pylon-injection vs upstream/main:"; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/feature/pylon-injection...upstream/main; "custom-infill vs main:"; git rev-list --left-right --count feature/custom-infill...main; "pylon vs custom-infill:"; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/feature/pylon-injection...feature/custom-infill; "merge-base dates:"; git log -1 --format="%h %ci %s" \(git merge-base main upstream/main\); git log -1 --format="%h %ci %s" upstream/main)
PowerShell(git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages feature/custom-infill upstream/main | Select-Object -Skip 1 | Select-Object -First 60; "exit: $LASTEXITCODE")
PowerShell(git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only main upstream/main | Select-String -Pattern "^CONFLICT|^Auto-merging" | Where-Object { $_ -match "CONFLICT" })

PowerShell("=== main: zaa / per-feature keys in PrintConfig.hpp ==="; git show main:src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.hpp | Select-String -Pattern "zaa|contour|_filament\\b|wall_filament|surface_filament|feature_filament" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) }; "=== upstream: same ==="; git show upstream/main:src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.hpp | Select-String -Pattern "zaa|contour|_filament\\b|wall_filament|surface_filament|feature_filament" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) })

PowerShell("pylon contains upstream ZAA \(0f366ddff1\)?"; git merge-base --is-ancestor 0f366ddff1 origin/feature/pylon-injection; $LASTEXITCODE; "pylon contains upstream divided-filament \(ea35b9ce68\)?"; git merge-base --is-ancestor ea35b9ce68 origin/feature/pylon-injection; $LASTEXITCODE; "pylon base:"; git log -1 --format="%h %ci %s" \(git merge-base origin/feature/pylon-injection upstream/main\); "pylon tip:"; git log -1 --format="%h %ci %s" origin/feature/pylon-injection; "custom-infill tip date:"; git log -1 --format="%h %ci" feature/custom-infill)

PowerShell("=== pylon PrintConfig.hpp zaa/filament keys ==="; git show origin/feature/pylon-injection:src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.hpp | Select-String -Pattern "zaa_|_filament\(_id\)?\\\)\\\)" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) }; "=== pylon ContourZ.cpp identical to upstream-at-its-base? ==="; git diff --stat \(git merge-base origin/feature/pylon-injection upstream/main\) origin/feature/pylon-injection -- src/libslic3r/ContourZ.cpp src/libslic3r/ContourZ.hpp)
